title: NATIVE ON build: threaded recording n0/th1/th2/th3 on native3d (Agent 4, S3 task #12, <= 45 min planned for a later window). Title/attract loop, no input needed
notes: BIN DIR: build/agent2/native3d-bin = native3 (S3 with fix-a) plus the draw.cpp hash=0 fix (perf-notes/agent4-draw-path.md S3.2; draw.cpp 5EA1F357...). All four arms run the same exe and cvars; only the environment differs. If a later native bin (an AOT pack for placement VS 0xAC449538 / PS 0xAC448F28, or a shader miss-cache bin) is staged before this matrix runs, move every arm to it together, after its own functional n-rows pass.

Every arm passes native_settings_frontend=false (native builds throw at start with the frontend on: 'Native setting is not registered: present_fsr_sharpness_reduction') and runs uncapped (native_fps_limit=0, framerate_limit=0). drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 gives the busiest-thread busy %.

ONE FRAME SOURCE: frames=perf on every arm (perf.csv frame_time_us, the per-present interval written next to native-frames.csv in the same present call: device.cpp:2266-2276, fps_counter.h:37). Same source as the OFF-build arms (d0/devoff/B), so results can be set beside window 4. Checked on 7 native runs (window-3 n0 x4, S3 N1-N3): window mean fps identical (delta <= 0.001%), median within 0.002 ms, p99 within 0.015 ms (bench/agent4/s3/perf-vs-native.json). LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS stays on in every arm as a cross-check only (same cost in every arm).

WINDOW: starts 60 s after the first frame (settle 5 + warm-up 55, firstframe mode), past the light-to-heavy title switch at 30-40 s; satisfies a runner min_window_after_ff_s of 60 without raising the warm-up. Flag any run whose window still shows the light phase. 60 s window, 3 repeats, round-robin order, no cold run.

No cold run: it is unscored, and its warm-up is capped at 10 s (ColdWarmupMax), which breaks the 60 s rule. n0-r1 then boots with the coldest file cache, which can only widen n0's spread (conservative).

TIME: 4 arms x 3 repeats = 12 runs, the same count as the n0/th1/th2 x4 version: -PlanOnly (05:05) says about 30 min (12 runs of about 142 s). Window 3 ran native runs about 16 s/run longer than the planner assumes (tick-loop lag, boot), so expect about 33-34 min; the worst window-3 overheads on every run would give about 41 min, inside the 45 min cap.

th3 (LEGO_NATIVE_FULL_DRAW_PREPARATION=1) is back, and th2 is no longer provisional: native2's N2/N3 logged 'Native GPU shader cache miss: hash=0x0' (67,220 / 44,968 lines) because the preparation paths planned draws whose captured vertex shader failed to bind. native3d's PrepareDrawGeometry skips those draws with the recorder's own failed-bind test; the recorder drops them at draw.cpp:2718-2725 as before, so the image does not change. native3d functional n0/n2/n3 (Agent 8, build/agent8/matrix/20261122-0452, 04:52-04:59, idle machine) PASS check_n_rows.py for n2 and n3 with 0 hash=0 lines in all three (native2: 0 / 67,220 / 44,968) and no new warning type (checked separately by Agent 4, bench/agent4/s3/check-native3d.json, and Agent 10, build/agent10/nb/).
game.log rotates at 5 MB and keeps 2 files. bench/agent4/check_n_rows.py reads game.1.log too and uses threads.csv names when the boot lines are gone.
No LEGO_NATIVE_TIMING, LEGO_NATIVE_STATE_CALLS, trace toggles or debug layer in any arm. The trace toggles also switch parallel draws off.

Check (bench/agent4/check_n_rows.py --baseline <this matrix's n0 runs> --rows n1=<th1> n2=<th2> n3=<th3>): th1-th3 log 'Native GPU: threaded recording ON (LEGO_NATIVE_THREADED=1)' once; 'Native draw batches:' is 'serial workers=0' (th1), 'parallel workers=2' (th2) and absent (th3: full preparation never calls NativeParallelDrawsEnabled); 'Native worker: last 600 frames ...' about once per 600 presents; worker threads 'Native GPU recording' (th1), 'Native GPU preparation' + 'Native GPU prepare 1/2' (th2), and those plus reclaim and recording (th3); no new warning type against n0, hash=0 included.

Decision (perf-notes/agent4-draw-path.md S2.12, adjusted for 3 repeats): a threaded arm counts only if its mean fps beats n0 in every one of the 3 round-robin rounds AND its median frame time is below n0's lowest median (beats n0's whole min..max spread), with mean fps reported next to the median (frame times can be bimodal). Compare only within this matrix: window 3's n0 used a 50 s window from 35 s, frames=native and the native2 bin.

arms.note: Agent 4 N0: native defaults, threaded recording off
Agent 4 N1: threaded recording only. Check 'Native draw batches: serial workers=0'
Agent 4 N2: threaded recording, 2 preparation workers, snapshot state = parallel draws. Check 'Native draw batches: parallel workers=2' and no hash=0 warnings
Agent 4 N3: threaded recording, 2 preparation workers, full draw preparation. No 'Native draw batches' line (expected); check the thread names and no hash=0 warnings
